name: @agentskillshub/mcp

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Find open-source AI agent skills & MCP servers in the AgentSkillsHub catalog (100K+ indexed, quality subset stars>=5). Natural-language query plus optional filters. Each result includes a security_grade and estimated_tokens so you can weigh safety and context-cost BEFORE selecting one.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query, e.g. 'scrape a website', 'postgres', '去 AI 味'.

max_security_risk.description: Cap the security risk. 'safe' = only 🟢 SAFE; 'caution' = SAFE or CAUTION. Excludes un-audited.

tools.name: audit_skill
tools.description: Free basic trust check for a skill: security grade, plain-English verdict, and quality score. Run this BEFORE installing/trusting a skill. Deep 5-dimension audit and auditing any GitHub URL (incl. <5★ / private) are Pro features.

depth.description: Only 'basic' is available for free; 'deep' points you to Pro.

tools.name: get_skill_install
tools.description: Get install commands for a skill plus a 'check before you install' safety line. Does NOT run anything — returns what to install, how, and what to verify first. The agent/user executes.

runtime.description: Target runtime — decides which install command is recommended.

tools.name: pro_search
tools.description: Pro members only: deep search that matches the FULL README text of 130K+ skills (not just name/description/tags), returns up to 200 results, with category + security-grade filters. Requires a member key in the ASH_PRO_KEY environment variable (get one at https://agentskillshub.top/pro/). Without a key this returns an upgrade note — use search_skills for free catalog search.

query.description: Deep query matched against full README text, e.g. 'sandbox escape mitigation'.

min_security.description: Exact security grade to filter to.

instructions: Search, audit, and install open-source AI agent skills & MCP servers from AgentSkillsHub (agentskillshub.top) — a directory of 100K+ skills, each security-graded and quality-scored. Call search_skills to discover, audit_skill before trusting a skill, and get_skill_install for install commands. Security grades: safe/caution/unsafe/reject, or 'unknown' = never audited (a black box — not 'probably fine').
